mn142:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn142:2.1: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī navaṃ dussayugaṃ ādāya yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn142:2.2: idaṃ me bhante, navaṃ dussayugaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa sāmaṃ kantaṃ sāmaṃ vāyitaṃ.
mn142:2.3: taṃ me bhante, bhagavā patigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā’ti.
mn142:2.4: evaṃ vutte bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca:
mn142:2.6: saṅghe te dinne ahañceva pūjito bhavissāmi saṅgho cā’ti.
mn142:2.7: dutiyampi kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn142:2.10: dutiyampi kho bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca:
mn142:2.12: saṅghe te dinne ahañceva pūjito bhavissāmi saṅgho cā’ti.

mn142:2.16: tatiyampi kho bhagavā mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca:
mn142:2.18: saṅghe te dinne ahañceva pūjito bhavissāmi saṅgho cā’ti.
mn142:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn142:3.2: ‘patigaṇhātu bhante, bhagavā mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā navaṃ dussayugaṃ.
mn142:3.3: bahūpakārā bhante, mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā,
mn142:3.6: bhagavantaṃ bhante, āgamma mahāpajāpatī gotamī buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gatā.
mn142:3.7: bhagavantaṃ bhante, āgamma mahāpajāpatī gotamī pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā, adinnādānā paṭiviratā, kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā, musāvādā paṭiviratā, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā.
mn142:3.8: bhagavantaṃ bhante, āgamma mahāpajāpatī gotamī buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgatā, saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgatā, ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā.
mn142:3.9: bhagavantaṃ bhante, āgamma mahāpajāpatī gotamī dukkhe nikkaṅkhā, dukkhasamudaye nikkaṅkhā, dukkhanirodhe nikkaṅkhā, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya nikkaṅkhā.
mn142:4.2: yaṃ hi ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, imassānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ
mn142:4.4: yaṃ hānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma. pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti. imassānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ
mn142:4.6: yaṃ hānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti, imassānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi. yadidaṃ
mn142:4.8: yaṃ hānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma dukkhe nikkaṅkho hoti, dukkhasamudaye nikkaṅkho hoti, dukkhanirodhe nikkaṅkho hoti, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya nikkaṅkho hoti. imassānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ
mn142:6.1: tatrānanda, tiracchānagate dānaṃ datvā sataguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā. puthujjanadussīle dānaṃ datvā sahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā. puthujjanasīlavante dānaṃ datvā satasahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā. bāhirake kāmesu vītarāge dānaṃ datvā koṭisatasahassaguṇā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā. sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne dānaṃ datvā asaṅkheyyā appameyyā dakkhiṇā pāṭikaṅkhitabbā. ko pana vādo sotāpanne, ko pana vādo sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne, ko pana vādo sakadāgāmissa, ko pana vādo anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne, ko pana vādo anāgāmissa, ko pana vādo arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanne, ko pana vādo tathāgatasāvake arahante, ko pana vādo paccekabuddhe, ko pana vādo tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddheti.
mn142:7.5: tathāgate parinibbute ubhato saṅghe dānaṃ deti.
mn142:7.11: ‘ettakā me bhikkhū ca bhikkhuniyo ca saṅghato uddissathā’ti dānaṃ deti.
mn142:7.13: ‘ettakā me bhikkhū saṅghato uddissathā’ti dānaṃ deti,
mn142:7.15: ‘ettikā me bhikkhuniyo saṅghato uddissathā’ti dānaṃ deti,
mn142:8.1: bhavissanti kho panānanda, anāgatamaddhānaṃ gotrabhuno kāsāvakaṇṭhā dussīlā pāpadhammā,
mn142:8.2: tesu dussīlesu saṅghaṃ uddissa dānaṃ dassanti.
mn142:8.3: tadāpahaṃ ānanda, saṅghagataṃ dakkhiṇaṃ asaṅkheyyaṃ appameyyaṃ vadāmi.
mn142:8.4: natvevāhaṃ ānanda, kenaci pariyāyena saṅghagatāya dakkhiṇāya pāṭipuggalikaṃ dānaṃ mahapphalataraṃ vadāmi.
mn142:9.3: atthānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:9.4: atthānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
mn142:9.5: atthānanda, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:9.6: atthānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
mn142:10.1: kathañcānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato:
mn142:10.2: idhānanda, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
mn142:10.3: evaṃ kho ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:11.1: kathañcānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato:
mn142:11.2: idhānanda, dāyako hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
mn142:11.3: evaṃ kho ānanda, dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati no dāyakato.
mn142:12.1: kathañcānanda, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato:
mn142:12.2: idhānanda, dāyako ca hoti dussīlo pāpadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti dussīlā pāpadhammā.
mn142:12.3: evaṃ kho ānanda, dakkhiṇā neva dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato.
mn142:13.1: kathañcānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca:
mn142:13.2: idhānanda, dāyako ca hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā ca honti sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā.
mn142:13.3: evaṃ kho ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato ceva visujjhati paṭiggāhakato ca.
mn142:13.4: imā kho ānanda, catasso dakkhiṇā visuddhiyoti.
mn142:14.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
mn142:14.24: vibhaṅgavaggo catuttho. tassa vaggassa uddānaṃ: bhaddekānanda kaccāna lomasakaṅgiyā
